definitions.explanation: The amount of water contained in a material, usually expressed as a percentage. Used in contexts like soil science, food, materials engineering, and cosmetics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{含水量|がんすいりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: We measure the water content of the soil.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{木材|もくざい}→木材：13017_mokuzai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{含水量|がんすいりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This lumber has a high moisture content.

examples.japanese: ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{含水量|がんすいりょう}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{出来上|できあ}がり→出来上がり：21122_dekiagari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: When baking bread, the moisture content of the dough greatly affects the final result.

notes:
Compound of {含水|がんすい} (containing water) + ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (amount).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {含水量|がんすいりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: has high water content
- {含水量|がんすいりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: has low water content
- {含水量|がんすいりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure the water content
- {含水量|がんすいりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to check the moisture level

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧: moisture; water — more general, used in everyday contexts about food, skin, etc.
- ⟦{湿度|しつど}→湿度：03181_shitsudo⟧: humidity — water in the air, not in a material
- {水分量|すいぶんりょう}: moisture amount — more casual everyday equivalent
